features.quote: Explicit `finish` tool. Why: gives the agent a graceful, in-band way to stop with a summary
features.justification_quote: lets us capture its *self-report* of success vs the ground truth, and ... distinguishes "decided to stop" from "ran out of turns."

features.quote: after `max_idle_turns` idle turns we end as `idle`
features.justification_quote: prevents burning turns on pure prose while still recording that the model stopped acting

features.quote: The agent gets the full `max_turns` (default 30) even if it keeps failing
features.justification_quote: long enough to give degradation time to emerge, bounded enough to keep cost finite
